insight.description: Connects major EU crypto rules and adjacent measures—such as market regulation, AML, and tax reporting—into a coherent account of how the regulatory landscape is changing.
Analyzes how the changes affect crypto firms, users, and markets, including relevant compliance burdens, protections, or shifts in business activity.
Compares EU-wide rules with national approaches and explains which activities or entities fall within, or outside, the measures discussed.
Draws clear conclusions about implementation timelines, remaining uncertainty or uneven coverage, and what these mean for the industry's near-term direction.

readability.description: Presents the changes in a logical order, grouping related measures such as market rules, AML, and tax rather than blending distinct regimes together.
Makes it easy to tell whether each measure applies across the EU or reflects a national approach, and which crypto activities it covers.
Clearly distinguishes adoption, entry into force, and application dates where relevant, so readers can follow when changes take effect.
Defines or briefly explains regulatory acronyms and technical terms needed to understand the changes and their effects.
